approved_case_mapping.test: EPMCDMETST-67315-TC-001: loads inventory and verifies backend data in the UI
EPMCDMETST-67315-TC-002: detects inventory request, data, or loading errors
EPMCDMETST-67315-TC-003: compares the complete inventory list and count with the response

outputs.network_strategy: Capture observed XHR/fetch responses and request failures only from the login action through the point the inventory cards are visible. Capture page errors and console errors within the same loading window. Identify product records only by matching observed scalar values to rendered product names; require exactly one matching response candidate and include observed response URLs, statuses, and object-array lengths in ambiguity diagnostics. Do not assume an endpoint or schema.
outputs.api_contract_limitation: Repository evidence contains no inventory API route, response schema, or field contract. The test discovers a matching response from actual browser traffic rather than fabricating an endpoint or contract. Repository/UI evidence contains no separate visible inventory product-count label or locator; a cart badge is not an inventory count and is not used as one.
outputs.product_count_gap: The approved cases require a separately displayed product count, but repository evidence establishes no visible inventory-count label. The automation does not assert or represent the number of matching inventory-card locators as displayed text.
outputs.approved_expectation_reconciliation: The automation verifies that the number of rendered inventory cards equals the number of uniquely matched records in the observed response, and compares each rendered product and its details with that response. This reconciles data/count consistency only; it does not verify that a separate count value is displayed. The approved displayed-count requirement remains uncovered pending evidence of the UI element or clarification of the requirement.
outputs.diagnostics: Playwright retains trace, screenshot, and video on failure per playwright.config.ts. Each generated test attaches sanitized load-window response metadata, matched inventory response data, rendered product details, XHR/fetch request failures, page errors, and console errors.
outputs.validation_result: PASS after retry 1: npm run test:e2e -- --list discovered 6 tests across 2 files, including all 3 generated inventory cases. The successful list-only rerun used temporary sentinel environment values; it did not execute tests or contact an application. No tests were executed for retry 2.
outputs.unresolved_requirement_gap: The approved cases require a separately displayed product count, but repository search/UI evidence found no visible inventory-count label or locator. Rendered inventory-card locator count versus response-record count is not displayed-count coverage, and the automation does not claim it as such. This remains unresolved pending requirement clarification/removal or evidence of the actual UI count element. Approved test cases and expectations were not changed.
outputs.test_command: npm run test:e2e (not run; execution is routed by the orchestrator)
outputs.execution_target: Configured Playwright MCP server at .vscode/mcp.json; browser execution was not requested in this phase.

next_recommendation: Request approved requirement clarification or UI evidence for the separately displayed inventory count, then return control to the orchestrator.
